coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 6 of 9 ground-truth variable items (67%): weight-only quantization with FP16 activations and unquantized KV caches, WikiText-2 with 2048-token windows, an unquantized FP16 baseline, 2/3/4-bit weights, the four method combinations represented by RTN/GPTQ crossed with rotation OFF/ON, and perplexity.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses symmetric per-channel quantization and a group-size sensitivity axis instead of fixed per-column asymmetric quantization. Makes 13B optional and explicitly excludes the required 70B model. Its stability analysis concerns variance rather than detecting Inf/NaN failures. Additional calibration, downstream-task, and clipping variations depart from the specified controlled experiment.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth findings.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing all required conclusions, including QuaRot-GPTQ's low-bit improvements, RTN's low-precision failures, partial stabilization of RTN, and the 70B W2 perplexity reduction from 25.30 to 5.60.
